# HyperSpy

> HyperSpy is an open source Python library for the interactive analysis of multidimensional datasets that can be described as multidimensional arrays of a given signal (e.g., a 2D array of spectra, also known as spectrum image). It provides tools for processing, analyzing, and visualizing data from electron microscopy, spectroscopy, and related experimental techniques.

HyperSpy makes it straightforward to apply analytical procedures that operate on an individual signal to multidimensional arrays, while providing easy access to analytical tools that exploit the multidimensionality of the dataset. The library's modular structure makes it easy to add features to analyze many different types of signals.

Key features include:
- Support for multidimensional signal processing
- Interactive data visualization and exploration
- Machine learning tools (PCA, ICA, NMF)
- Model fitting and curve fitting capabilities
- Extensive I/O support for various file formats
- Integration with the scientific Python ecosystem (NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, Dask)

## Domains

- [exspy - EELS](https://github.com/hyperspy/exspy): Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy analysis and core electron microscopy functionality
- [exspy - EDS](https://github.com/hyperspy/exspy): Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy and X-ray microanalysis tools
- [lumispy](https://github.com/LumiSpy/lumispy): Luminescence spectroscopy including cathodoluminescence (CL), photoluminescence (PL), electroluminescence (EL), and time-resolved measurements
- [kikuchipy](https://github.com/pyxem/kikuchipy): Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD) processing, simulating and indexing of diffraction patterns
- [pyxem](https://github.com/pyxem/pyxem): Multi-dimensional diffraction microscopy including 4D-STEM, electron diffraction, and related techniques
- [holospy](https://github.com/hyperspy/holospy): Electron holography reconstruction and analysis
- [etspy](https://github.com/etspy/etspy): Electron tomography processing and reconstruction tools

## HyperSpy Ecosystem

- [exspy](https://github.com/hyperspy/exspy): Electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) and X-ray energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS)
- [lumispy](https://github.com/LumiSpy/lumispy): Analysis of luminescence spectroscopy data (CL, PL, EL, time-resolved measurements)
- [pyxem](https://github.com/pyxem/pyxem): Multi-dimensional diffraction microscopy (4D-STEM, electron diffraction)
- [kikuchipy](https://github.com/pyxem/kikuchipy): Processing, simulating and indexing of electron backscatter diffraction patterns
- [holospy](https://github.com/hyperspy/holospy): Electron holography reconstruction and analysis
- [etspy](https://github.com/etspy/etspy): Electron tomography processing and reconstruction tools
- [rosettasciio](https://github.com/hyperspy/rosettasciio): Reading and writing of scientific data formats
- [hyperspy-gui-ipywidgets](https://github.com/hyperspy/hyperspy-gui-ipywidgets): Interactive widgets for Jupyter notebooks
- [hyperspy-gui-traitsui](https://github.com/hyperspy/hyperspy-gui-traitsui): Desktop GUI widgets using TraitsUI
- [Official extensions list](https://github.com/hyperspy/hyperspy-extensions-list): Complete and up-to-date list of HyperSpy extensions
